## Summary

Describe the focused change and the user-facing or maintainer-facing impact.

## Reviewer Notes

Call out anything reviewers should pay attention to:

- Setup, command, security, release, or day-to-day usage impact.
- Local or manual checks that CI cannot prove.
- Known limitations, follow-up work, or intentionally skipped checks.

## Manual Telegram Evidence

If this changes live bot behavior, describe the private chat, group, forum topic, voice, attachment, menu, or queueing checks that were run. If not applicable, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I will follow `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is submitted under `CONTRIBUTOR-AGREEMENT.md`.
- [ ] I have not included bot tokens, OpenAI keys, private transcripts, private screenshots, or local credential paths.
- [ ] I updated documentation for setup, commands, security posture, release workflow, or day-to-day usage changes.
- [ ] I listed reviewer notes and manual Telegram evidence where they are relevant.
